_source: el2: TP-045 (docs/tool-proposals/TP-045-xrun-el2-trap.md) + docs/runplans/el2-2-xnu.md in the super repo (B2 run needs build.sh --el2-trap --boot-xnu, cpus=1 per spec 3.4 (b) item 5 (ii), boot-arg sweetel2=1; require_opts = flag value must equal); gpu: docs/HANDOFF.md section 43g6 item 1 (gputest19-24 lacked --gpu-handover, build.sh:57,218-220); sweetmali=1 is NOT required (not every GPU probe loads the Mali kext); timing: patch 0115 (boot-arg sweetlogts=1, docs/AUTOMATION.md:525), patch 0047 (sweetlog=0 disables the log, default on, so sweetlog=0 is forbidden; a boot-arg sweetlogs does not exist in bootargs-known.txt); wlan: tools/build-xnu-image.sh on branch tools/wlanfw3 lines 16,40 (--wlan-hold adds sweetwlan=N, patch 0120) and NO require_flags on wlan: --wlan-hold is a shim/build.sh flag (W-D1 done, w3a-s34) that tools/xrun does not accept on this branch nor in w3a-s34 (grep tools/xrun: absent; xrun exits 2 unknown option), so requiring it makes the intent unpassable; add it here when xrun passes it through. Labels: HANDOFF uses wd2-1, wd2-1b, wd2-2, wd3-1 (prefix wd+digit so wdog/wdt do not match; prefixes are matched case-insensitively). docs/GOALS.md W-D2 / HANDOFF wd3-1 run line (--wlan-hold --wlan-level 1)
